description: This file defines a React functional component 'OnboardForm', which implements a 3-step onboarding wizard for collecting team information (name, size, work mode). It manages local state for step navigation and validation, uses custom UI components, interacts with global state via dispatch, and navigates upon completion. It is a central UI component for user onboarding within the application.

methods.name: OnboardForm
methods.description: React functional component implementing a multi-step onboarding form with validation, navigation, and state management.
